d1.summary: upgrade/recover/rollback account for every registered resource (launcher, API child, console listener, descendants) including orphans after the launcher died. A live process not provable as this config/data/target identity is unknown_live_resource and blocks; unmatched candidates are never filtered into an empty proven set. Spawn trees match canonical paths, start identity and whole-segment tokens; unreaped zombies are not writers.

d2.summary: Spawn identity (pid+start) is persisted in the journal immediately after spawn and before health; recovery stops the persisted tree even without an instance record. The record-missing window is real (target suppresses the record via the injected PA_SUPPRESS_INSTANCE_RECORD env, answers health, then cleanup proves the stop before reverting). A coordinator-exit fault stops the tree after health. Settled journal states (confirmed/binary_rolled_back/reverted) allow a new operation; an unsettled journal refuses re-entry before planning with upgrade_recover_required, and doctor reports the single next action.
